blocks.text: Ta lekcja jest o zasadach i radach: «musisz okazać dokument», «muszę przeczytać umowę», «warto odpocząć», «nie wolno łamać zasad», «nie musisz kupować». Najważniejsze — nie pomylić «nie wolno» z «nie musisz».

examples.en: I have to read the contract.
I don't have to buy supplies.

blocks.text: must + czynność jak w słowniku — «muszę», «koniecznie»: You must take your belongings. Must jest jedno dla wszystkich, bez -s, i po nim nigdy nie ma to.

examples.en: We must check the expiry date.

fixes.wrong: You must to take your belongings.

drill.why: Po must — czynność jak w słowniku, bez -s i bez to.

blocks.text: have to + czynność — «trzeba», «muszę», często z powodu okoliczności: I have to read the contract. Z he / she — has to. Bez to sens jest inny: I have read — «już przeczytałem».

formula.text: I / you / we / they: have to + czynność

examples.en: I have to read the contract.
She has to enter her occupation.
I occasionally have to work late.
examples.translation: Czasem muszę zostać dłużej w pracy.

examples.en: He has to follow the diversion.
I have to show proof of purchase.

fixes.wrong: I has to read the contract.
fixes.right: I have to read the contract.

fixes.wrong: She have to enter her occupation.
fixes.right: She has to enter her occupation.

blocks.text: should + czynność — rada: «powinieneś», «warto». You should consult a teacher — «powinieneś poradzić się nauczyciela». Should też bez -s i bez to.

examples.en: We should use up the milk.

fixes.wrong: You should to consult a teacher.

blocks.text: ought to — też rada, prawie jak should, tylko z to: You ought to set a budget — «należałoby ustalić budżet». Tu to jest potrzebne, a -s nie.

examples.en: You ought to set a budget.
We ought to find the cause.
You ought to keep in mind the departure time.
We ought to express our gratitude.

fixes.wrong: You ought read the national news.
fixes.right: You ought to read the national news.

fixes.wrong: You oughts to read the national news.
fixes.right: You ought to read the national news.

drill.why: Po ought zawsze to — inaczej niż po should i must.

blocks.text: mustn't to zakaz: «nie wolno», «w żadnym razie». You mustn't ignore the rules — «nie wolno łamać zasad». Uwaga: polskie «nie musisz» to NIE mustn't, tylko don't have to.

fixes.wrong: You mustn't to ignore the rules.

sections.title: don't have to i needn't — «nie musisz»

blocks.text: «Nie musisz, nie trzeba» — don't / doesn't have to albo needn't: I don't have to buy supplies; You needn't reply straight away. To nie zakaz! Zakaz to mustn't. Po needn't nie ma to, po don't have — jest.

formula.text: nie muszę: don't / doesn't have to + czynność

examples.en: I don't have to buy supplies.
She doesn't have to bring a photocopy.
He doesn't have to head back yet.

fixes.wrong: She don't have to bring a photocopy.
fixes.right: She doesn't have to bring a photocopy.

fixes.wrong: I don't has to buy supplies.
fixes.right: I don't have to buy supplies.

fixes.wrong: You needn't to collect it personally.

drill.question: Farby na zajęciach daje organizator. Nie musisz ich kupować — ale też nie jest to zakazane. Co powiesz?
drill.optionB: I don't have to buy supplies.
drill.explain: «Nie muszę» — don't have to. Mustn't znaczy «nie wolno».

blocks.text: Uprzejma prośba z lekcji 19 pojawia się i tutaj: Could I pay separately? — «czy mogę zapłacić osobno?». Could pierwsze, potem I i czynność bez to.

examples.en: Could I send it by post?

fixes.wrong: You must to take your belongings.
I has to read the contract.
fixes.right: I have to read the contract.

fixes.wrong: You ought read the national news.
fixes.right: You ought to read the national news.

fixes.wrong: You needn't to collect it personally.

blocks.text: To jest tylko w have to i ought to. Po must, should, mustn't i needn't — od razu czynność. Nie wolno — mustn't, nie musisz — don't have to albo needn't.
Koniecznie — must. Trzeba, muszę — have / has to. Rada — should albo ought to. Nie wolno — mustn't. Nie musisz — don't have to albo needn't.

examples.en: We must go through the list.
He should stand up for his friend.

examples.translation: Nie musisz tłumaczyć się ze swojego wyboru.
